cd /workspace/tmp && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json,sys
from fractions import Fraction
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import genbig2
x=genbig2.gen(1); TRUTH=x['_truth']
caps={e['id']:e['capacity'] for e in x['edges']}
for si,s in enumerate(x['snapshots']):
    truth=TRUTH[si]
    L={e['id']:Fraction(0) for e in x['edges']}
    for c,v in zip(x['commodities'],truth):
        W=sum(r['weight'] for r in c['routes'])
        for r in c['routes']:
            amt=Fraction(v*r['weight'],W)
            for e in r['edges']: L[e]+=amt
    probs=[]
    for e in x['edges']:
        if L[e['id']]>caps[e['id']]: probs.append(('cap',e['id'],str(L[e['id']]),caps[e['id']]))
    for o in s['observations']:
        if o['metric']=='link': val=L[o['target']]
        elif o['metric']=='demand': val=truth[[c['id'] for c in x['commodities']].index(o['target'])]
        elif o['metric']=='ingress': val=sum(v for c,v in zip(x['commodities'],truth) if c['source']==o['target'])
        else: val=sum(v for c,v in zip(x['commodities'],truth) if c['target']==o['target'])
        if not (o['lower']<=val<=o['upper']):
            probs.append(('obs',o['id'],o['metric'],o['target'],str(val),o['lower'],o['upper'],o['domain']))
    print('snap',si,'problems',len(probs))
    for p in probs[:8]: print('   ',p)
